Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in data synthesis and role identification. In Step 3, the Planner incorrectly concluded that Phil Rosen was credited as a "photographer" and that he had three distinct roles (director, cinematographer, photographer). The evidence provided by the WebSurfer in Step 1 explicitly states that Phil Rosen was a "film director and cinematographer" and mentions he was a "cameraman" during the silent era. "Cameraman" is a specific job title within the broader profession of cinematography; it does not constitute a separate, distinct professional scope comparable to "director" or "screenwriter." By splitting "cinematographer/cameraman" into two separate roles and adding "photographer" (which is not listed as a distinct credit in the provided text), the Planner artificially inflated Phil Rosen's scope. Consequently, the Planner reached the wrong conclusion (that Phil Rosen has a broader scope) by misinterpreting the definition of professional roles, whereas the correct analysis shows Delmer Daves has a broader scope (Director, Screenwriter, Producer) compared to Phil Rosen (Director, Cinematographer).
